title: Concept: A declared name is one edit away from `once_cell`
description: Cargo.toml declares a declared crate name in Cargo.toml within one edit of `once_cell`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `once_cell`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: Cargo resolves these names against the registry, so a name that only looks like the intended crate compiles foreign code into the binary. The name this rule expects is `once_cell`.
